integrity: Complete symbolic twelve-column recurrence proof and two standalone independently implemented finite verifiers; independent scholarly evaluation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only all-on binary grid instances of height three; no other initial states or widths.
The three-row minimum number of presses and eight-seed recurrence are known from Caro–Klostermeyer (2003) and not claimed original.
Full text of Goldwasser–Klostermeyer–Ware (2002) was not accessible in its entirety; equivalent unindexed weight enumerators may exist.
title: Complete all-on press-weight distribution on three-row Lights Out strips
